resources.string: vivo X Fold6 · PC Mode only
Compatibility after upgrading to OriginOS 7 is unknown, update with caution
Switching requires Shizuku: install Shizuku → start its service → tap Allow in this app\'s dialog.
After re-plugging the HDMI cable, vivo PC Mode pushes the resolution back to 2K; tap 4K Ultra to restore it. A dimmed button means the display is already at that resolution.

This app runs shell commands through Shizuku to change the vivo PC Mode resolution from 2K to 4K, or restore it back to 2K. Follow the 4 steps below once; after that you only need to redo them if you reboot the phone.
Download and install Shizuku from an app store or shizuku.rikka.app. Don\'t open this app yet — start the Shizuku service first.

Start it via wireless debugging, no computer needed.\nSettings → Developer options → enable Wireless debugging → tap "Pair device with pairing code" → enter the code in the notification → back in Shizuku tap "Start via wireless debugging".
Return to X Fold6 Cast, tap "4K Ultra" or "2K Default", and tap Allow when Shizuku asks. One-time only. Once granted, the display info appears under the title.
Back in PC Mode, look at the external display: if it is noticeably sharper it is on 4K. If it is still 2K, re-plug the HDMI cable and tap "4K Ultra" again.
"Shizuku not running": the service died, redo step 2. A service started via wireless debugging stops after a reboot and has to be started again.
Granted but tapping does nothing: make sure the HDMI cable is connected and the display is taken over by vivo PC Mode; if needed re-plug the cable and tap "4K Ultra" again.
May stop working after a system update, e.g. upgrading to OriginOS 7.
